title: fix(zeroc #29): isolate str* frozen seeds to 1 contract fn — kill __errno_location contamination that broke darwin selfhost byte-eq on flip default-ON
body: zeroc #29 str* flip 실결함(darwin selfhost byte-eq RED) 근본수정. 근본원인(Fable 검증): 프로즌 seed = hxlcl_core.hexa 전체모듈 Route-C 덤프로, .globl-demotion이 hxlcl_strcmp 1개만 global로 남기지만 syscall-leaf 형제들(fork/execve/open…)의 bl __errno_location(glibc전용·darwin엔 __error뿐)이 local body로 잔존→consume default-ON시 build/hexat 링크가 darwin서 Undefined ___errno_location으로 폭발. free/calloc가 default-ON+darwin GREEN인건 seed가 깨끗해서가 아니라 hxlcl_free/calloc이 darwin 링크서 미참조(archive lazy-pull)라 멤버 미-pull=잠복폭탄. 수정: (1) tool/isolate_native_seed.py=transitive-closure 텍스트 슬라이서, seed를 contract 1개 함수로 격리(형제 호출은 shim/carrier-served external로 잔존)—15 seed 각 25-29k→600-800줄, errno 완전제거(darwin native cc+nm+link+run 검증·closure=Fable예측 strcmp:0/str*:_hexa_bool/strdup:+malloc 정확일치). (2) 5 regen 스크립트에 격리 패스+bake-time errno FATAL 게이트. (3) stage_resolve_runtime_a에 consume-time nm-gate(_rn_seed_und_gate)=비-carrier undefined 검출시 tri-state FALLBACK-SHIM(auto)/FATAL(strict)—늦은 hexat RED를 우아한 degradation으로. 격리 seed는 통과·옛 오염 seed는 정확히 검출 확인. str* default OFF=byteeq중립. 이 PR은 strcmp flip default-ON도 포함(격리 위 byteeq 3-target GREEN=fix 실증). convergence stage-resolve-runtime-a-3.

feat(borrowck): HEXA-OWN E4 write-through-borrowed (HX3023, Rust E0506) — pre-kill assign-arm scan over E2 loan registry
body: HEXA-OWN 사다리 E4 런그(Rust E0506 'cannot assign to `x` because it is borrowed'). #4557(E2+E3 대출 레지스트리+첫 대출충돌 HX3021) 위에 구축 — 이미 하강기에 등록된 live 대출이 있는 비-전역 식별자 `x`에 대한 할당 `x = RHS`를 쓰기-스루 위반으로 표면화. 구현(compiler/lower/hir_to_mir.hexa): ① `_bck_ref_find_write_through(origin)` — 레지스트리 END-스캔으로 origin==x인 ANY live 대출 검색(불변성 무관 — 쓰기는 &와 &mut 모두 무효화); ② `_bck_emit_write_through(...)` — HX3023 emit + STRICT(HX3014/HX3019/HX3021 동일 caller-override 패턴); ③ assign-arm PRE-KILL 스캔 — `_bck_ref_kill(lhs.text)` 직전에 배치하여 레지스트리가 x를 origin으로 하는 모든 live 대출을 반영하는 순서 보장(E3.5 디자인 통찰). VERIFY-FIRST 실측: assign-arm의 킬은 lhs 자신의 ref-대출명일 때만 발화(`_bck_find_ref(lhs.text)>=0`)하므로 정규 E4 사례(`let r=&x; x=5`에서 x는 origin이지 대출명 아님)는 킬이 발화하지 않아 순서 위해는 실제로 무관하지만, PRE-KILL이 보수-정확 순서. catalog(compiler/diag/catalog.hexa) HX3023 DiagSpec 추가 — HX3022 다음 free 코드 단일성 게이트 GREEN(58 코드). 설명에 flow-insensitive FP 클래스 문서화(NLL last-use 미구현으로 `let r=&x; <use r>; x=5`도 발화 = 보수-loud-over-quiet, E2/E3 동일 정책). 테스트(compiler/check/borrowck_test.hexa): `_run_write_through_probe` 추가(HX3021 runner 클론). 위험 hz_write_through(`let r=&x; x=5`)→×1, hz_write_through_mut(`let m=&mut x; x=9`)→×1, 대조 fp_write_no_borrow(대출 없는 할당)→0, fp_write_diff_origin(`let r=&y; x=5`)→0, fp_use_then_write(문서화된 flow-insensitive FP)→×1. OFF 전수 비어있는 스트림 단정. STRICT→Error 밴드. BYTEEQ-NEUTRAL: 모두 `_bck_active`(HEXA_BORROWCK=1, default-OFF) 게이트 → 기본 emit 불변, gen3≡gen4. 다음 rung=E5(지원 미구현).

title: feat(zeroc #29 prereq-a): WALL-2 strdup native seed-consume — DEFAULT-OFF (byteeq-neutral · seeds pending pool bake)
body: Adds the RT-NATIVE-STRDUP prereq-(a) plumbing so a later flip PR can drop libc strdup from the runtime.a nm-UND floor. New tool/regen_hxlcl_strdup_native_s.sh (clone of the landed free/calloc regen: aprime_cc --emit=asm hxlcl_core.hexa + .globl DEMOTION to a 1-symbol hxlcl_strdup contract, all 3 triples x86_64/arm64-linux/arm64 since abi=pointer; keeps the .private_extern strip + pext ||true assertion = the darwin multidef fix). New RT-NATIVE-STRDUP seed-consume block in tool/stage_resolve_runtime_a mirroring RT-NATIVE-CALLOC: tri-state HEXA_RT_NATIVE_STRDUP {0 DEFAULT=off/neutral, auto=graceful-WARN, 1=strict}, seed self/native/hxlcl_strdup_{x86_64,arm64-linux,arm64}.s, .globl==1 safety gate, -DHEXA_RT_NATIVE_STRDUP on success, graceful FALLBACK-SHIM WARN on missing seed. BYTEEQ-NEUTRAL: default 0 → block skipped → shim.o + archive byte-identical; the 3 seeds are NOT baked in this PR (pending pool aprime_cc bake — the parent bakes after), so the resolver graceful-skips until they land. free/calloc/realloc blocks byte-untouched (pure insertion). NO seed .s committed. convergence stage-resolve-runtime-a-2 · regen-hxlcl-strdup-native-s-sh-1.

title: fix(ci byteeq path-gap): trigger byte-eq gates on build-path scripts (stage_resolve_runtime_a et al)
body: The self-host byte-eq gates (selfhost-byteeq-gate·determinism-gate·miscompile-zero-gate·selfhost-codegen-guard·selfhost-crossemit-smoke·selfhost-byteeq-real) only path-filtered self/**+compiler/**+their own gate script — so a runtime.a-composition change made purely in tool/stage_resolve_runtime_a (e.g. this calloc flip 0→auto) linked a NEW compiler binary yet triggered NONE of them (only faithful-nobaseline, which globs tool/**). release-integrity requires byteeq 3-target GREEN for bit-changing runtime. Fix: add the build-path scripts (tool/stage_resolve_runtime_a·release_build·stage_build_hexa·stage_prebuild_hexat) to all 6 gates' push+PR paths (additive OR — no docs-PR deadlock; required set = path-less selfhost-gates-summary untouched). Now byteeq runs on THIS PR. Excluded: selfhost-determinism-gate (promoted-slot artifact, no PR-tree build) · nobaseline-gate (already tool/**). Design: Fable bqmevjzjk.

body: hxlcl_calloc의 OLD LIVE-EMIT(--emit=asm on live binary)를 #4548 free FROZEN-SEED-CONSUME 패턴으로 교체(prereq-a·flip 아님). 근본원인=#4489/#4545 free와 동일 empty-emit 취약(faithful CI가 emit 바이너리를 CLI hexa로 오해석→.hexa-first compat cmd_run이 --emit=asm 무시→빈 .s→FATAL→faithful RED). aprime_cc는 runtime.a 필요→Stage 0b에 존재불가라 live-emit은 구조적으로 불가능. 신규 tool/regen_hxlcl_calloc_native_s.sh(free regen 클론·CONTRACT=hxlcl_calloc·SRC=hxlcl_core.hexa·.globl DEMOTION 1-symbol·kept==1&&total==1 SAFETY·chmod +x). resolver: _rnca live-emit 블록(drv+--emit=asm+objcopy isolate+no-binary FATAL) 삭제→seed-consume 블록(_rnca_mode 기본 0=byteeq-neutral·target→seed case·.globl==1 SAFETY·$CC -c seed.s→build/hxlcl_calloc_native.o·성공시 -DHEXA_RT_NATIVE_CALLOC+member·tri-state 0/auto/1: auto=graceful FALLBACK-SHIM·1=strict FATAL). demotion이 단일 strong def 고립→objcopy 불필요(free와 동일). inner hxlcl_malloc callee는 shim이 계속 제공(undefined extern·co-drop 없음). 3 seeds self/native/hxlcl_calloc_{x86_64,arm64-linux,arm64}.s는 pool aprime_cc bake 대기(parent가 summer에서 bake+commit)라 미포함→seed-consume graceful-skip. realloc은 HARD-WALL(shim malloc이 헤더 미기록↔native realloc이 헤더 읽음→garbage)이라 미변경(live-emit 유지). bash -n GREEN. title: fix(release cuda-verify): install cuobjdump toolkit sub-package — #4404 PTX guard died command-not-found, cuda asset missing since v0.553
body: FOLLOW-UP defect of #4404 (measured, release runs 28605028220~28606402407): the new PTX-embed Verify assertion died with `cuobjdump: command not found` — cuobjdump ships in its own toolkit sub-package (cuda-cuobjdump-12-6), NOT in nvcc, and the Jimver install list lacked it → cuda job RED on every release since #4404 → NO -cuda asset uploaded (v0.553~v0.574) → installer silently fell back to the CPU asset on GPU hosts (observed on summer: v0.574.0 install → cuda tarball fetch failed → CPU asset). The fail-loud guard itself worked as designed (refused to pass unverified). FIX: add "cuobjdump" to Jimver sub-packages + harden the Verify resolution (toolkit bin → PATH → find, still fail-loud when genuinely absent). The gencode PTX embed itself compiled clean in CI (job reached Verify with build+dlink+package GREEN).

title: fix(release cuda-asset): embed PTX in runtime_cuda fatbin — sm_80-SASS-only asset silently no-ops on newer GPUs (RTX5070 sm_120)
body: ROOT-CAUSE (measured, summer RTX5070 sm_120): release CI cuda job builds runtime_cuda.o with -gencode arch=compute_80,code=sm_80 ONLY = sm_80 SASS, NO PTX. On sm_120 every kernel launch fails cudaErrorNoKernelImageForDevice silently (cuda_available()==1, banners fire, device buffers stay zero) -> shipped -cuda asset produces garbage: bytegpt_devres_smoke argmax dev=0, max|delta|=551 (v0.547.0 asset). FIX: add -gencode arch=compute_$SM,code=compute_$SM (PTX embed, driver JIT-forward) to both nvcc calls in stage_resolve_runtime_a + build_cuda_runtime; measured PASS after re-splicing same v0.547.0 source with PTX: argmax 32==32==32, max|delta|=2.5e-06, dev-vs-dev 0.0. GUARD: release.yml cuda Verify step now asserts cuobjdump -lptx lists a .ptx image (fail-loud, regression cannot ship). Convergence entry RELEASE-CUDA-ASSET-SASS-ONLY-NO-PTX added (sibling of BUILD-CUDA-RUNTIME-CUDA-HOME-SM80-ZEROS #4216). Item-11 disposition: transpiler hexa_cc.c seed staleness ALREADY RESOLVED by HEXA_SEED_CONVERGE=1 ship path (v0.540.1+ hexat carries forge_dispatch_layernorm/read_f32_at mappings, verified by strings + summer consumer smoke); the REAL residual ship-blocker was this SASS-only cuda asset.

title: ci(.gitattributes): CHANGELOG.jsonl merge=union — kill the append-conflict loop (native git root fix)
body: 근본문제 root-cause fix: append-only CHANGELOG.jsonl이 multi-session에서 매 머지마다 line-1 충돌(이번 세션 #4134가 5회+ grind). git native 정석 = merge=union 드라이버(append-only 파일 표준·CHANGELOG.md엔 이미 적용됨). 두 PR이 둘 다 prepend해도 git이 양쪽을 union(합집합)으로 자동 머지 → 충돌 0. 조각파일(CHANGELOG.d) 접근은 폐기(sidecar 구현도 revert). workflow 변경 없음·실증: 합성 충돌이 union으로 자동해소(양쪽 엔트리 보존). 이 .gitattributes가 main에 land하면 #4134 포함 모든 향후 PR이 CHANGELOG.jsonl 자동 union.
